propose.title: Submit Final Project Proposal
propose.recommendedTrack: Also recommended for students in cluster
propose.recommendedTrackSubtitle: The project will also be listed under the selected cluster but managed under the cluster specified above
propose.academicSupervisorSubtitle: Must be a faculty member of the Engineering Faculty
propose.objectiveSubtitle: A paragraph describing the expected achievements and final deliverables of the project. List the deliverables as bullet points.
propose.scopeSubtitle: Detailed breakdown of student tasks: list the tasks (serving the required achievements) in order of project progression. Completing all tasks will lead to successful completion of the project objectives and all deliverables.
propose.relevantRequiredCoursesSubtitle: Required Computer Engineering courses that can help students understand the academic background, professional area, and knowledge base the project relies on. This selection is optional and intended for guidance only.
propose.prereqSubtitle: No need to mention mandatory courses. Please specify a course (number and name) that is a prerequisite for the proposed project. This course can be taken concurrently with the start of the project. If there is no prerequisite, leave this field empty.
propose.referencesSubtitle: Please write as bullet points (bibliographic list). It is recommended to include direct links where possible.
propose.successMessage: Your proposal has been received and will be reviewed by the course management staff. A submission confirmation email has just been sent to the supervisor and academic supervisor, including a link to edit the proposal until it receives final approval.
propose.editUnavailableMessage: A proposal that already received final approval cannot be edited, or the edit link is invalid.
